arcane-archer.summary: A ranged caster who fights with INT, enchants arrows on the fly and fires spells straight through the bow.

assassin.summary: Strikes from stealth or the flank for heavy crits, then slips back into hiding mid-fight.

captain.summary: A battlefield leader who spends Inspiration Points to hasten, empower and protect allies.

lurker.summary: Waits for enemies to act first, then punishes anyone whose turn has already passed.

magus.summary: A staff caster whose spells reach further, cover more ground and can crit without an attack roll.

marksman.summary: Gives up movement for accuracy, guards lanes with Overwatch and hits harder from high ground.

sage.summary: A concentration caster who swaps spells mid-fight, converts damage types and upgrades spells for free.

samurai.summary: Flows between four sword stances, each grown with its own Bushido skills.

sentinel.summary: A shield-bearer who hardens nearby allies, takes hits meant for them and taunts enemies away.

skirmisher.summary: Moves and acts outside their own turn, cutting into the initiative order with extra movement and actions.

spellblade.summary: A melee caster who fights with INT, enchants their blade and spends Spellstrike Points on magical strikes.

spellslinger.summary: A rapid caster who bends action costs, spends Alacrity Points to cast faster and is rewarded for variety.
